# epitelesis

> Typed subprocess policy, lifecycle supervision, and aggregate execution evidence.

## Canonical documents

- [README.md](README.md): supported dependency pin and fixed v1 contract
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md): typestate, supervisor, portability, and evidence model
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): trust boundary and process-group limitation
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): repository workflow and release-truth checks
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): implementation invariants

## Machine-readable state

- [_llm/architecture.toml](_llm/architecture.toml): components and lifecycle invariants
- [_llm/current_state.toml](_llm/current_state.toml): supported release fact and current phase
- [_llm/decisions.toml](_llm/decisions.toml): accepted design and release decisions

## Verification

- [scripts/verify_release_truth.py](scripts/verify_release_truth.py): dependency-free release alignment and tag verifier
- [scripts/tests/test_verify_release_truth.py](scripts/tests/test_verify_release_truth.py): deterministic temporary-repository coverage
